name: journey-audit
description: Multi-agent customer journey audit for AI-generated CJMs and user flows: CJM logic, edge-case scenarios, simulated cognitive load, and a verdict with priorities P0–P2, goals with metrics and fix specs. English and Russian.

interface.shortDescription: Audit customer journey maps: logic, edge cases, cognitive load, fix specs
interface.longDescription: Use Journey Audit to review a customer journey map, user flow or prototype — especially one drafted by AI. Three independent auditors check the logic of the map, the secondary and edge-case scenarios it skips (with synthetic personas), and the cognitive load of every step (load index, Keystroke-Level Model, fatigue, exit points). A verdict step merges the findings into priorities P0–P2, goals with metrics and implementation-ready specs with acceptance criteria. Works in English and Russian.
defaultPrompt: Audit the customer journey map in docs/journey.md and tell me what to fix first.
What edge cases did we miss in this checkout flow?
Проверь CJM: логика, краевые сценарии, нагрузка. Дай приоритеты и спеки.
